children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may retest support at 4,732 ringgit per metric ton, a break below which may trigger a fall into the 4,677-4,711 ringgit range.
The bounce off support is a pullback toward a triple-top. The pullback is expected to end around 4,799 ringgit.
A fall below 4,766 ringgit would indicate the continuation of the downtrend. A break above 4,799 ringgit may lead to a move back into the 4,820-4,840 ringgit range.
